b2-ifjusagikultura-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Beat Music at the Ifipark
b2-ifjusagikultura-01.scenario: On a walking tour of the Várkert Bazár in Budapest, a guide asks you how beat music reached Hungary and what rules the Budai Ifjúsági Park had.
b2-ifjusagikultura-01.prompt: Tell the guide where beat music came from and what the park's rules were about.
cues: Say where beat music came from
Say what the park's strict rules were about
b2-ifjusagikultura-01.target: A beatzene Nyugatról érkezett Magyarországra. A Budai Ifjúsági Parkban szigorú szabályok voltak a hajviseletre.
b2-ifjusagikultura-01.english: Beat music came to Hungary from the West. In the Budai Ifjúsági Park there were strict rules about hairstyle.
b2-ifjusagikultura-01.canDo: I can say how beat music reached Hungary and what rules the Budai Ifjúsági Park had.

b2-ifjusagikultura-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Táncház
b2-ifjusagikultura-02.scenario: At a táncház in Budapest, an old teacher asks you how the first táncház came about and who the young people learned from.
b2-ifjusagikultura-02.prompt: Tell the teacher when the first city táncház was held and who the young people learned the tunes from.
cues: Say when the first táncház was held
Say who the young people learned the tunes from
b2-ifjusagikultura-02.target: Az első városi táncházat 1972 májusában tartották Budapesten. A fiatalok az idős falusi adatközlőktől tanulták meg a dallamokat.
b2-ifjusagikultura-02.english: The first city táncház was held in Budapest in May 1972. The young people learned the tunes from the elderly village informants.
b2-ifjusagikultura-02.canDo: I can say how the first táncház in 1972 brought village dance and music to young people in Budapest.

b2-ifjusagikultura-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cassettes and the Fekete Lyuk
b2-ifjusagikultura-03.scenario: At a record fair in Budapest, a collector asks you how underground bands spread their songs in the 1980s and what the Fekete Lyuk was.
b2-ifjusagikultura-03.prompt: Tell the collector how the songs spread and what the Fekete Lyuk was.
cues: Say what the Fekete Lyuk was
b2-ifjusagikultura-03.target: Az alternatív zenekarok dalai házilag másolt szamizdat kazettákon terjedtek. A Fekete Lyuk a budapesti alternatív szubkultúra egyik fontos találkozóhelye volt.
b2-ifjusagikultura-03.english: The songs of the alternative bands spread on home-copied samizdat cassettes. The Fekete Lyuk was one of the important meeting places of the Budapest alternative subculture.
b2-ifjusagikultura-03.canDo: I can say how underground bands spread their music on cassettes in the 1980s and what the Fekete Lyuk club was.

b2-ifjusagikultura-04.title: Communicative Challenge: From Diáksziget to Sziget
b2-ifjusagikultura-04.scenario: On the ferry to Hajógyári Island in Budapest, a festival-goer asks you how the Sziget began and what it became.
b2-ifjusagikultura-04.prompt: Tell the festival-goer when the Diáksziget started and what the Sziget Festival grew into.
b2-ifjusagikultura-04.target: A Diáksziget 1993-ban indult. Később a Sziget Fesztivál Európa egyik legnagyobb összművészeti rendezvényévé nőtte ki magát.
b2-ifjusagikultura-04.english: The Diáksziget started in 1993. Later the Sziget Festival grew into one of Europe's largest multi-arts events.
b2-ifjusagikultura-04.canDo: I can say how the Diáksziget of 1993 became the Sziget Festival.

b2-ifjusagikultura-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Slang and English Words
b2-ifjusagikultura-05.scenario: In a university café in Budapest, a student asks you what linguists think about English words in Hungarian slang.
b2-ifjusagikultura-05.prompt: Tell the student that linguists disagree, and what each side says.
cues: Say what the other side says
b2-ifjusagikultura-05.target: A nyelvészek véleménye megoszlik: egyesek szerint a magyar nyelvtan beépíti az új szavakat, mások aggódnak a helyesírás miatt.
b2-ifjusagikultura-05.english: Linguists' opinions differ: some say Hungarian grammar absorbs the new words, others worry about spelling.
b2-ifjusagikultura-05.canDo: I can report that linguists disagree about English words in Hungarian slang and say what each side says.

b2-ifjusagikultura-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Three Stages of Youth Culture
b2-ifjusagikultura-consolidation.scenario: At a youth-culture exhibition in Budapest, a curator asks you to say one thing about the beat era, the táncház movement and the Sziget Festival.
b2-ifjusagikultura-consolidation.prompt: Say one thing about each of the three.
b2-ifjusagikultura-consolidation.target: A beatzene Nyugatról érkezett Magyarországra. Az első városi táncházat 1972-ben tartották. A Sziget 1993-ban Diákszigetként indult.
b2-ifjusagikultura-consolidation.english: Beat music came to Hungary from the West. The first city táncház was held in 1972. The Sziget started in 1993 as the Diáksziget.
b2-ifjusagikultura-consolidation.canDo: I can say what the beat era, the táncház movement and the Sziget Festival each were.
